sidebar.ahp_description: Defining weights manually can be subjective and inconsistent. The Analytic Hierarchy Process uses pairwise comparisons to mathematically derive optimal weights while measuring your decision consistency.
sidebar.dimension_weighting_note: Note: When all dimensions have equal weights you will get the "Political" IMPT. We do not recommended using it for decision making, as it assumes that all dimensions are equally important, which can mask inequalities. We reccomend the usage of AHP methodology to determine the weights that best suit your local context.

tutorial.prompt_tour: Would you like to take a quick tour of the dashboard?
tutorial.mobile_step_menu: On mobile, you can access the settings and layers by tapping this menu button.
tutorial.step_1: Welcome to the biclaR Parking dashboard! This planning and decision-support tool helps identify and prioritize locations for bicycle parking implementation in the Lisbon Metropolitan Area.
tutorial.step_2: Use the left sidebar to switch between model outputs and indicator layers.
tutorial.step_3: Under Outputs, explore the results of the different models developed for sizing and prioritizing bicycle parking.
tutorial.step_5: Switch to the Indicators tab to explore parking ratios, mobility, census, land use, contextual data, and raw geographic layers.
tutorial.step_6: Use these filters to switch between layer variations (such as minimum/maximum estimates, transport modes, or categories).
tutorial.step_7: Switch between geographic scales: Municipality, Freguesia, or Grid.
tutorial.step_8: Filter by region to focus the map and rescale values locally.
tutorial.step_9: The Regional Contrasts panel shows the highest and lowest values alongside summary measures of central tendency and spread. Clicking an area on the map replaces it with detailed area statistics.
tutorial.step_11: Check the legend for the active layer's color scale, description, data sources, and reference period.
tutorial.step_12: Use these controls to zoom and switch base map styles.
tutorial.step_13: Use the toolbar at the top of the sidebar for quick utilities.
tutorial.step_14: Toggle between light and dark mode.
tutorial.step_attribute_table: Open the attribute table to search, sort, and browse values for all columns in the selected metric group.
tutorial.step_17: Download the GeoJSON and CSV datasets.
tutorial.step_18: Learn more about the project, authors, methodology, and funding.
tutorial.step_19: Reopen this guided tour at any time.
tutorial.step_10_mobile: Click any area on the map to inspect its details.
tutorial.dynamic_step_1: You can define your own weights for each dimension. Use these sliders to adjust how much each dimension contributes to your custom index.
tutorial.dynamic_step_1_note: Please mind this note before proceeding.
tutorial.dynamic_step_2: If you're not sure about the weights, take the AHP survey. It helps you derive consistent weights through simple pairwise comparisons.
tutorial.dynamic_step_3: Once you're satisfied with your custom index, you can download the results for all areas in a CSV file.
